dataset.description:
The project researches the main effects of climatic influences on the transformation of contemporary local building traditions. This will be done by comparing vernacular buildings regionally and trans-culturally. From these results the project will generate several scientific publications. Reference Data, Findings and related Metadata for each publication are compiled in a single Zenodo repository versioned with a DOI.
This Data Management Plan (DMP) refers to the curated data generated by the Climate Arch Project as a basis for scientific publication of project results.
dataset.title: Climate Arch Data
